invariants_acknowledged: Owner ruling 2026-10-13: evolve report_schedules in place; no new schedule table; no DROP TABLE/COLUMN; legacy columns stay.
A schedule that is active must reference a report template or a report definition (DB CHECK + router BAD_REQUEST).
tenantId comes only from ctx.tenant; every mutation is scoped by { id, tenantId } and a foreign-tenant id yields NOT_FOUND.

Mutations require ADMIN/MANAGER/OWNER/SUPER_ADMIN; reads need the ANALYTICS module entitlement (moduleTenantProcedure).
Page follows the module-settings playbook: PageHeader + 12-col bento, canonical EmptyState without a CTA, TagsTab via forwardRef, colorToken CHECK.
Real data only: no seeded schedules and no fake delivery status; the page states delivery is pending IFC-308.
